name: Sodium radiation-pressure geometry and shadow kernels
purpose: Verify Earth umbra geometry, heliocentric inverse-square scaling, and the absolute one-AU velocity dependence of the production Na radiation-pressure kernel against the published Combi et al. curve.
configuration: Static Moon-centred geometry; Na table compiled into libAMPS.a.
inputs: zero radial velocity at 1 and 2 AU
14 unobscured Figure 7 velocities from -45 through +45 km/s at 1 AU
independent_reference: Cylinder/half-line eclipse geometry; inverse-square irradiance invariant; Combi, DiSanti, and Fink, Icarus 130 (1997), Figure 7 upper panel, DOI 10.1006/icar.1997.5832, independently digitized from the NASA NTRS 19990024948 reproduction at 150 and 300 dpi.
units: geometry: m; velocity: m s^-1; production acceleration: m s^-2; publication acceleration: cm s^-2
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred solar-orbital Cartesian fixture; positive heliocentric radial velocity is away from the Sun; publication comparison is normalized to 1 AU; no epoch.
procedure: Verify the committed digitization package and its SHA-256 values; invoke both compiled production kernels; compare exact eclipse classifications, the 1-AU/2-AU ratio, and each production acceleration with the independently digitized publication curve. The expected curve is never read from Na.cpp.
metrics: 14 absolute acceleration residuals in cm s^-2
acceptance_criteria: Exact eclipse classifications; acceleration ratio 4 within 1e-14 relative; digitization QA PASS with cross-raster differences <=0.5 cm s^-2; and every production acceleration within the predeclared 0.5 cm s^-2 graphical uncertainty of the two-raster mean.
expected_pass_result: Umbra geometry and inverse-square scaling satisfy their invariants, and the production velocity curve agrees with the published Combi curve to the declared graphical uncertainty.
expected_failure_modes: production table inconsistent with the published curve
required_data: Combi et al. (1997) Figure 7 upper panel as reproduced in NASA NTRS 19990024948
status_semantics: PASS verifies the local production kernel against the publication curve only to the frozen graphical uncertainty. It does not recover the unavailable historical digitization and does not establish that the full production mover applies or gates the force correctly; that remains I07.
